title: tab_le_scalar
description: `tab_le_scalar` compares samples from a source array with a scalar using “less than or equal to” and writes the results to a destination array. Its source and destination arrays are set by the first and second creation arguments or changed with `src` and `dst` messages; a four-float list specifies the source onset, destination onset, number of samples, and scalar value, with comparison limited by the shorter array length.
